semiconductor_relevance: High — ASRA focuses on research and development of high-performance digital semiconductors specifically for automotive applications, particularly in the area of System on a Chip (SoC) technology.
summary: Advanced SoC Research for Automotive (ASRA) is a collaborative initiative established by 14 Japanese companies to advance research and development in high-performance digital semiconductors for in-vehicle applications. The organization aims to leverage chiplet technology to enhance the capabilities of intelligent and electrified automobiles, addressing critical automotive-specific challenges.
capabilities: Research and development of chiplet technology for automotive applications
Development of high-performance in-vehicle computing systems
Collaboration framework linking automakers with semiconductor vendors

regional_presence.Japan: ASRA is established in Japan, bringing together local automotive and semiconductor expertise.
